በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — and sons of (ወ- 'and' + plural construct)
ተአዘዙ: አዘዘ — command (3mp perfect, passive-reflexive T stem ተአዘዘ 'were commanded'; the T stem can also mean 'obey' (?))
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
ይብሉ: ብህለ — they say (3mp subjunctive/imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
ወሰብአ: ሰብእ — and men (ወ- + noun; construct 'men of' in ሰብአ ቤቱ 'his household')
ሀቡ: ሀበ — come! (G 2mp imperative of 'give', used as a hortative particle before a 1cp jussive: ሀቡ ናንግሦ 'come, let us make him king')
በህየ: ህየ — there, in that place (በ- + adverb)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
በዝየ: ዝየ — here (በ- + adverb ዝየ 'here'; the በ- adds nothing to the sense)
ሥምረቱ: ሥምረት — good pleasure, favour (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', from ሠምረ)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ለዓለመ: ዓለም — age, world, eternity (noun, construct state 'age-of'; ለ- 'for')
አውሥኡ: አውሥአ — they answered (causative 3mp perfect, from ወሥአ)
አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ)
ወአውሥኡ: አውሥአ — and they answered (ወ- + causative 3mp perf., w-ś-ʾ)
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
ተዐድዎ: ተዐደወ — transgressing, overstepping (verbal noun of ተዐደወ; the final -ዎ is the verbal-noun ending, not 'his')
እምቃለ: ቃል — from the voice, word of (እም- + noun, construct)
አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ወእምትእዛዘ: ትእዛዝ — and from the command of (ወ- + እም- + noun, construct)
ንገብር: ገብረ — we do, make (1cp imperfect, G)
ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
ወበጽዮን: ጽዮን — and by Zion (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'by' + proper name)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ወለዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and to his seed (ወ- + ለ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ሀቡኬ: ሀበ — give; ሀቡ imperative pl. + enclitic ኬ, an exhortation 'come now' (ሀበ, imperative)
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ወለእመኒ: ለእመ — and even if (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ 'if' + enclitic -ኒ 'even')
ወተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they arose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
አንሰ: አነ — as for me (1cs pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ስእንኩ: ስእነ — I was unable (1cs perf., G, s-ʾ-n)
ነቢረ: ነበረ — to dwell (infinitive of ነበረ 'sit, dwell')
እምብዝኀ: ብዝኅ — from the abundance of (እም- 'from' + noun ብዝኅ 'multitude', construct ብዝኀ)
ንግረኒኬ: ነገረ — tell me then (2ms imperative ንግር + -ኒ 'me' + enclitic -ኬ 'then, now')
ወኢኮነ: ኮነ — and was/is not (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n)
ታንሶሱ: አንሶሰወ — she walks about (3fs imperfect, quadriliteral አንሶሰወ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people')
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
ወካህናትኒ: ካህን — and the priests also (ወ- + plural ካህናት + enclitic -ኒ)
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
ዓመት: ዓመት — year (noun, fem.; after a numeral)
ቅድስተ: ቅድስት — holy place, sanctuary (noun, fem.; construct 'holy of')
ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
በእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — on this account, concerning this (በእንተ + ዝ, preposition + demonstrative)
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወትኩን: ኮነ — and let it be, may it be (ወ- + 3fs jussive)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ)
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city')
ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
ሠናያነ: ሠናይ — good ones (adjective, plural ሠናያን, accusative, used as a noun)
ፍጡነ: ፍጡን — quick, quickly (adjective, accusative as adverb)
ለእግዝእትየ: እግዝእት — for my lady, to my lady (ለ- + noun, fem. + -የ '1cs my')
ነሐውር: ሖረ — we go, we will go (1cp imperfect)
እመቦ: እመ — if there is (እመ + ቦ 'there is')
ሐመር: ሐመር — ship, boat (noun; ከርሠ ሐመር 'belly of a ship', hold, here of the Ark; uncertain)
ወንነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and let us take her (ወ- + 1cp jussive + -ኣ 'her')
ወወሀብዎ: ወሀበ — and they gave him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ 'him')
ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ) · 'by one' (በአሐቲ ፍናው 'by one road')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun)
ተረፋተ: ተረፍ — remnants (noun, plural ተረፋት, accusative or construct)
ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
ወተፈሥሐ: ተፈሥሐ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
